decisive_items: a solid, well-demarcated, hyperechoic, hypoperfused 1.3 × 1.1 cm mass at the tail of the right epididymis
a painless, round, hazelnut-sized mass localized to the tail of the right epididymis
response.rationale: Solid, well-demarcated, painless epididymal tail mass in a young male with normal tumor markers and no invasion is classic for adenomatoid tumor, the most common benign epididymal neoplasm; sperm granuloma is less likely without trauma/inflammation, and cyst is contradicted by solid hyperechoic hypoperfused imaging.

rejected.why: Too broad; the specific solid epididymal tail mass features support adenomatoid tumor rather than a generic epididymal tumor.
Ultrasound shows a solid, hyperechoic, hypoperfused mass, not a cystic/anechoic lesion; epididymal cyst is contradicted.
